t: The No Nonsense 490 Frame Sealant White 310ml is a low odour, low modulus, neutral curing silicone sealant designed for professional applications. It offers primerless adhesion to a variety of materials including glass, plastics, masonry substrates, metals, and woods, making it a versatile choice for trade professionals. This highly flexible sealant provides excellent movement capability, ideal for sealing around the perimeter of windows and door frames or joints. Its weather and temperature-resistant properties ensure durability for both interior and exterior use, and it can also be applied to HVAC ducting, pipework, and draining joints.
b: Suitable for Use on Most Building Substrates, Glazing, Kitchens, Bathrooms & Industrial Applications
